unsubscribe.confirm.title: Stop the weekly email?
unsubscribe.confirm.body: One click and the Wednesday digest stops. Your account, cities, genres and feeds all stay as they are.
unsubscribe.done.title: Unsubscribed
unsubscribe.done.body: You won't get the weekly email any more. Your account and everything you've followed are untouched — you can turn the digest back on from Settings whenever you like.
subscribe.confirm.title: Confirm your weekly digest
subscribe.confirm.body: One click and the Wednesday email starts. You can change what it covers, or stop it entirely, at any time.
subscribe.done.title: You're subscribed
subscribe.done.body: The first digest goes out on Wednesday morning. To change cities or genres, add your listening history, or stop it, enter this same address and we'll email you a link — there is no password.
subscribe.expired.title: That link has expired
subscribe.expired.body: Confirmation links last seven days. Ask for a new one from the home page and it will arrive in a moment.
link.invalid.title: That link isn't valid
link.invalid.body: It may have already been used, or it was truncated by your mail client.
error.generic.title: Something went wrong
error.generic.body: Please try again in a moment.
login.title: Your Wednesday email
login.body: Enter your address and we'll email you a link — whether you're starting the digest or coming back to change what it covers. No password to remember.
login.footnote: One email every Wednesday. One-click unsubscribe, any time.
notFound.title: That page isn't here.
notFound.body: The link may be from an old email, or the address may have a typo in it. Nothing else is affected — the rest of the site is working.
login.spotify: Spotify needs an account to attach itself to, so this comes first. Enter your address, click the link we email you, and you'll land straight on Spotify's permission screen.
login.sent.title: Check your inbox
login.sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in an hour. You can close this page.
overview.next.label: next digest
overview.next.body: Delivery is scheduled in your own timezone, so it stays in the morning year-round. The exact minute drifts a little — Cloudflare spreads scheduled work across the hour.
overview.paused: Your digest is currently paused. Turn it back on in {settings}.
overview.setup.neither: Pick at least one city and one genre and the first digest will go out this Wednesday.
overview.setup.noCities: You have genres but no cities yet — add a city to start receiving listings.
overview.setup.noGenres: You have cities but no genres yet — add a genre so there is something to filter by.
overview.cities.heading: Cities
overview.cities.hint: Queried once per city, then filtered by your genres.
overview.genres.heading: Genres
overview.genres.hint: Genres you chose, plus any inferred from your feeds.
overview.artists.heading: Artists
overview.artists.hint: Everyone the digest looks for by name, ranked by how strongly you follow them.
overview.artists.hintMore: Your top {shown} of {count}, ranked by how strongly you follow them.
overview.try.heading: Try it now
overview.try.hint: Builds this week's digest from live data. Reports the rendered email size, which is the one thing you can't check by eye.
overview.feeds.heading: Feeds
overview.feeds.hint: Screenshots you've fed in, and what was learned from them.
overview.feeds.pending: {count} waiting for you to confirm what was read.
feed.heading: My feed
feed.hint: {window} — the same scoring the Wednesday email uses, so this is what it would say if it went out now.
feed.hint.dateOrder: In date order — follow some artists and the best matches rise to the top.
feed.unconfigured: The feed needs the service role key, which is not configured on this deployment.
feed.empty.title: nothing this week
feed.empty.noCity: You haven't followed a city yet — that is the one thing the feed cannot guess.
feed.empty.noMatch: No listed shows matched your genres or artists. Listings are refreshed by the weekly run, so a brand-new account can look empty until then.
feed.unfiltered: You haven't told us what you listen to yet, so this is everything listed in {cities} — not a filtered selection.
pinned.heading: Pinned
pinned.hint: Saved from a search or your feed. These are kept as their own copy, so they stay here after the listing itself has rolled out of our cache.
pinned.empty.title: nothing pinned yet
pinned.empty.body: Pin a show from {feed} or {search}, and it will wait here with an add-to-calendar button.
pinned.none.title: nothing coming up
pinned.none.body: Everything you’ve pinned has already happened. They are listed below until you remove them.
pinned.past.heading: Already happened
pinned.past.hint: Kept, not cleaned up — they are yours to remove.
settings.delivery.heading: Delivery
settings.delivery.hint: The weekly job runs at a fixed UTC time; delivery is then released when your own local clock reaches this hour, which is what keeps it in the morning through daylight saving.
settings.enabled.hint: Unchecking this is the same as unsubscribing from the email. Nothing you've followed is lost.
settings.drift: Cloudflare spreads scheduled work across the hour it is triggered in, so the exact minute drifts. “Wednesday morning” is reliable; a precise time is not.
settings.account.heading: Account
settings.account.hint: Your address, as used for sign-in and delivery.
settings.delete.heading: Delete account
settings.delete.hint: Removes your profile, subscriptions, genres, artists and feeds. This cannot be undone.
landing.meta.title: Weekly concert email & ticket on-sale alerts — likelylist
landing.meta.description: One email every Wednesday morning: what goes on sale this week and who's playing near you, filtered by your cities, genres and Spotify. Free, no account, US only.
landing.deleted: Your account and everything in it have been deleted. Nothing is kept, and no more email will be sent.
landing.h1: The shows you'd have found out about too late.
landing.sub: Every Wednesday morning, one email: what goes on sale this week, and who's playing near you in the next seven days — filtered by the cities and genres you follow, the artists you name, and what your music app says you actually listen to.
landing.unseeded.hint: The weekly email is not taking signups yet.
landing.step.email.label: 01 / your email
landing.step.email.title: One address, one confirmation
landing.step.email.body: No password, no account to set up. Pick your city and a genre or two, confirm from your inbox, and you're subscribed. Coming back later means asking for a link — that's the whole login.
landing.step.artists.label: 02 / your artists
landing.step.artists.title: Name the ones you keep missing
landing.step.artists.body: Search for anyone you don't want to miss again, or screenshot your Spotify or Apple Music home screen and let it read the names off. Their shows reach you even in a genre you don't follow.
landing.step.midweek.label: 03 / midweek
landing.step.midweek.title: One email, Wednesday morning
landing.step.midweek.body: What goes on sale this week — the part you can still act on — then who's playing, where and when, with links out to YouTube and Spotify.
landing.spotify.label: new / spotify
landing.spotify.title: Import your favourite artists in one go
landing.spotify.signIn: You'll be asked for your email first — Spotify needs an account to attach to.
landing.spotify.body: Connect Spotify once and it reads your top fifty artists and follows them for you — their shows reach you even in a genre you don't follow. It asks for one permission, your top artists, and nothing else: not your playlists, not your listening history. It refreshes monthly, and disconnecting stops it.
landing.honest.heading: what it is honest about
landing.honest.lineup: Listings come from Ticketmaster, which does not publish billing order. likelylist marks the act it can identify as the headliner and labels everyone else same bill — it will not invent an opening act it cannot verify.
landing.honest.screenshot: Reading a screenshot is not perfect. Everything it thinks it found is shown to you for confirmation before it changes anything, and the image itself is read once and not kept.
landing.honest.onsale: On-sale dates are only as good as what Ticketmaster has published. Plenty of events have none yet, and presales are not distinguished from the general onsale — so this tells you what has been announced, not everything that will happen.
landing.honest.us: United States listings only for now. Coverage outside the US runs on a different, much thinner Ticketmaster API.
landing.attribution: Event data via Ticketmaster. Video data via YouTube
landing.digest.onTheWay: Your digest is on the way.
landing.digest.paused: Your digest is paused, so nothing is on the way.
landing.digest.resume: Turn it back on in {settings} and the next one goes out on Wednesday.
card.pin.title: Pin this show
card.unpin.title: Remove from your pinned shows
card.pin.failed: That did not save. Try again.
calendar.icsNote: Apple downloads a .ics file, which also works in Outlook and Fantastical.
